en: Black‑and‑white interior view of a church with wooden pews leading toward a chancel and altar. The altar has a large multi‑panel painting dominated by a crucifixion scene, flanked by flower arrangements. Elegant chandeliers hang from the ceiling, and a raised wooden pulpit with a decorative canopy stands to the left. On the back wall are hymn boards with numbers. Printed text along the bottom identifies the location as Alingsås Stadskyrkan and credits the photographer and publisher in Helsingborg.
